purpose: Manual opponent shortlist recall audit. The app surfaces plausible partners; the user makes the final keep/drop and ticket decision.
universe: Corrected opponent_rank_audit_v2 eligible-axis sample; JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher.

protocol.market_proxy_warning: Historical market order is final popularity because exact T-15 snapshots are unavailable. Live use must rely on the user's entered T-15 market and be forward logged.

candidate_definition.candidate3: Market top2 excluding axis + at most one best structural rescue outside the market base
candidate_definition.candidate4: Market top3 excluding axis + at most one best structural rescue outside the market base
candidate_definition.candidate5: Market top4 excluding axis + at most one best structural rescue outside the market base
candidate_definition.structural_rescue: Lowest Ability rank + M3 rank + P10 penalty score; P10 penalty 0 (<20%), +1 (20-49.9%), +2 (50-64.9%), +4 (>=65%); tie-break by horse number.
candidate_definition.duplicate_policy: If the best structural horse is already inside the market base, no extra horse is added. Candidate count is therefore a maximum, not a forced exact count.

candidate6_sanity_check.definition: Market top5 excluding axis + at most one structural rescue
candidate6_sanity_check.interpretation: No quinella gain versus candidate5 and only one additional 2026 wide capture; candidate5 is the practical elbow for manual review width.

trio.reason: The corrected rank audit does not retain cross-method horse identity needed to know whether both non-axis top3 finishers are inside the hybrid market-plus-structure union.

statistical_interpretation: Candidate sets are nested, so recall mechanically rises or stays flat as list width increases; the design decision is an elbow trade-off, not a claim that a larger list has a statistically significant betting edge.

Candidate5 versus Candidate3 adds 5 quinella-partner captures in 38 qualifying axis-top2 races (+13.2 percentage points) and 4 wide-partner captures in 50 qualifying axis-top3 races (+8.0 percentage points).
Candidate6 adds no quinella capture and only one 2026 wide capture, so five is a practical manual shortlist stop.
These results measure shortlist recall, not ROI and not profitability from buying every displayed horse.
caveats: Historical market order is final popularity proxy, not exact T-15 popularity.
The eligible-axis sample is small: 38 axis-top2 races for quinella-partner capture and 50 axis-top3 races for wide-partner capture.
Live T-15 shortlist composition must be forward logged before treating the historical proxy rates as operational rates.
The shortlist intentionally does not force an exact combination or stake.
